decisions.statement: The build is the build the mobile commands already run.
A build is made at Release.
A build is made at the commit it is handed.
Nothing here reads the worktree.
A ring credential the app bakes and nothing holds refuses the call before any push.
That refusal names the variable missing and the tiles a build would have had.
A commit origin does not carry is pushed there before anything is built.
The push carries the branch each repository is on rather than the commit alone.
A push that fails refuses the call rather than building on.
The report names the commit asked for before anything is built.
A build takes its own number rather than being told a number.
An upload skipped still has Apple validate the signed build.
An upload carried out reaches every internal tester of the app.
One build runs at a time on this workstation.
The lock is released whether the build finished or threw.
A build that threw is the operation's fault rather than the caller's.
The lines the build said are carried back in the report rather than printed.
Nothing is said until the build has finished.
Nothing here writes to an output stream.
The keychain password reaches no report.
The list this ship names things into is the one the cut names things into.

definition: an ios app built on the MacBook and handed to App Store Connect
